about: Places to submit an open-source developer tool. Each entry's route was read from its own page on the date above. `surya-distro targets` re-checks every entry live each time it runs.

targets.name: Claude plugin directory
targets.how: Submit from the Claude developer portal. It needs a paid Claude plan, and Anthropic reviews each submission before listing it.

targets.name: Official MCP Registry
targets.how: Publish a server.json with the mcp-publisher CLI. The registry holds metadata only, so the server needs a package on npm, PyPI, NuGet, OCI or MCPB, or a public remote endpoint.

targets.name: Awesome Claude Code
targets.how: Use the issue form in the web UI only. Pull requests and the gh CLI aren't accepted. One resource at a time.

targets.name: Awesome Claude Plugins
targets.how: Pull request. Their guide asks for a plugin folder in the standard layout and a README entry.

targets.name: Awesome Claude Code (jqueryscript)
targets.how: The contribution guide says it's under construction. Entries are added in dated batches, so check the README before suggesting one.

targets.name: Awesome MCP Servers
targets.how: Pull request adding one line to README.md in the right category. The server needs a public GitHub repo.

targets.name: mcpservers.org
targets.how: Free web form. It also feeds the wong2/awesome-mcp-servers list, which takes no pull requests. A paid upgrade is offered and isn't needed.

targets.name: MCP.so
targets.how: Web form with the repo URL. A one-time paid option publishes without review. Spending money is the owner's call.

targets.name: Glama MCP servers
targets.how: Use Add Server on the site. It needs a Glama sign-in.

targets.name: Changelog News
targets.how: Sign in, then submit. Your own work is welcome. Commercial products and tutorials aren't.

targets.name: PyCoder's Weekly
targets.how: Link form. They consider every link and feature some.

targets.name: Console
targets.how: Email the details. They review 2 to 3 tools a week against their selection criteria.
